description: Source code for the Probe component in WPEFramework, including classes for discovery, request handling, response creation, and broadcasting related to network service discovery.

classes.name: Discovery
classes.description: Represents discovery messages with various constructors for different discovery scenarios, providing access to message data and length.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Handles network listening, request reception, response sending, and request validation for network discovery.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Handles receiving responses, validating them, and reporting discovered devices with latency and model info.

methods.name: Probe::WebTransform::Transform
methods.description: Transforms incoming Web request data, checking for 'M-SEARCH' keyword in UDP messages.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::Listener
methods.description: Constructor initializing network link and joining a node.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a text body to a Web request.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::Received
methods.description: Handles incoming discovery requests, validates them, and responds if valid.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::Send
methods.description: Handles sending responses and moving to the next destination.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::ValidRequest
methods.description: Validates incoming requests, including signature verification if security is enabled.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::CreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a response message with latency and model info, optionally signing it.

methods.name: Probe::Broadcaster::ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes received data frames, parses responses, and reports valid devices.

methods.name: Probe::Broadcaster::ValidResponse
methods.description: Validates response signatures if security is enabled.

methods.name: Probe::Report
methods.description: Reports discovered devices with their URL, latency, model, and security status.
